doc: PROFILE.md §6.1: '`writers.gdal` `allow_empty`. Writing a raster from an empty point set becomes an option rather than an error.' The option has to be wired into the writer, not merely listed by `--options`: a pipeline that sets it on `writers.gdal` runs and produces its raster. At 2.5.0 the identical pipeline is refused with a non-zero status because the writer does not know the argument, so what is graded here is acceptance of the option, not any help text -- no shipped page states one. `filename` and `resolution` are `writers.gdal.rst`'s own Options ('Name of output file', 'Length of raster cell edges in X/Y units. [Required]'); pipeline.rst specifies the JSON array this runs.
